title: Thorns cover survives on a lava pool without catching fire
steps: fresh; spike-growth at 200,286 (charge 1); lava-pool at 200,286 (charge 1); wait 100 ticks; cell 200,286
happened: The cell is lava-pool, hot (heat 290 falling to 190 over 100 ticks) and still carries cover thorns (life 190). Thorns do not catch fire or burn off. Neighbouring grass also stays unburnt; census r4 showed cover:thorns=56 on 9 lava cells plus grass 72, no burning.
expected: Thorns are flammable (flammability 0.5, rule fire-thorns) and lava is a hot, fire-element terrain (lava rule: 'burns whatever stands on it'). A flammable cover on hot lava should ignite and burn away, and lava should be able to set adjacent grass alight.
evidence: cell 200,286 after lava-pool: "lava-pool, height 0, cover thorns, life 290, heat 290"; after 100 more ticks: "lava-pool, height 0, cover thorns, life 190, heat 190". census r4 at tick 112: "cover:thorns=56 t:grass=72 t:lava-pool=9", no burning=. By contrast, fire-bolt on the same thorns cell does ignite them ("The thorns catch fire").

title: Thunderwave deals more damage than its rule range, and a goblin seems to take two hits in one cast
steps: fresh; spawn goblin at 199,287; spawn goblin at 199,286 (both adjacent to me at 198,287); cast thunderwave at 198,287 charge 1; wait 0; creatures
happened: Log: "Goblin takes 7 thunderwave damage (3/10 HP) | Goblin takes 13 thunderwave damage (0/10 HP) | Goblin is defeated". Creatures afterwards: only goblin 2 at 3/10. So the goblin that was hit first (goblin 1, 10 HP) was hit for 7 and then for 13 in the same cast, and goblin 2 never shows as hit for 7 separately. A charge-1 cast of a spell with damage range 2-8 dealt 13.
expected: Thunderwave damage is rolled in its rule range [2,8]; each adjacent creature takes one hit per cast. A charge-1 cast should not deal 13 to one creature, and the log should show one hit per creature.
evidence: Run A (fresh, one goblin then cast): "Goblin takes 7 thunderwave damage (3/10 HP)" - consistent. Run B (fresh, two adjacent goblins, cast charge 1): "Goblin takes 7 thunderwave damage (3/10 HP) | Goblin takes 13 thunderwave damage (0/10 HP) | Goblin is defeated"; creatures: "goblin 2 at 199,286 hp 3/10". Run C (fresh, goblin at 199,287 at 3 HP after a 7-damage hit, then a second goblin at 199,286 with 10 HP, cast charge 1): "Goblin is defeated | Goblin takes 6 thunderwave damage (4/10 HP)" and in a previous run "Goblin takes 13 thunderwave damage (0/10 HP) | Goblin is defeated" with both goblins gone. Damage of 13 is above the spell's stated range [2,8].

title: Lava terrain from molten-boulder never crusts over
steps: fresh; molten-boulder at 200,290 (charge 3); wait 100; cell 200,290; wait 200; cell 200,290
happened: The cell is still "lava" 300 ticks after the boulder landed (at tick 100 and again at tick 300). It never became lava-crust or rock. The earlier world showed the same: a molten-boulder lava cell stayed "lava" for 500+ ticks (created tick 3540, still lava at tick 4040), and census showed t:lava=1 throughout.
expected: Terrain rule for lava: crustsTo lava-crust after crustFor 36 ticks, so the surface should crust within about 36 ticks, and lava-crust grows back to lava only on cracking. Lava-pool cools to rock after its hot time.
evidence: After molten-boulder: "200,290 lava, height -1" at tick 100; after 200 more ticks "200,290 lava, height -1" at tick 300. Rules: terrain.lava "crustsTo":"lava-crust","crustFor":36; terrain.lava-crust exists. Earlier run: "t:lava=1" in census at tick 3740 and 4040 (created at 3540).

title: Molten-boulder lava does not burn a creature standing on it, unlike lava-pool
steps: fresh; molten-boulder at 204,290 (charge 1); spawn goblin at 204,290; wait 60; creatures. Compare: fresh; lava-pool at 208,290 (charge 1); spawn goblin at 208,290; wait 30; creatures
happened: Goblin on the molten-boulder lava cell (cell reads "lava, height -1") is still 10/10 after 60 ticks. The goblin on a lava-pool cell takes "1 hot metal damage" every tick and is defeated within about 10 ticks.
expected: Both spells make lava. The lava-pool blurb says the pool "burns whatever stands on it", and lava is hot. A creature on molten-boulder lava should take the same burn.
evidence: After molten-boulder + goblin: "goblin 1 at 204,290 hp 10/10" at tick 60; cell "204,290 lava, height -1". Terrain rule terrain.lava has only "crustsTo" and "waterTo" fields, no heat/burn. Lava-pool spawn case: "Goblin takes 1 hot metal damage (9/10 HP) ... Goblin is defeated" over 30 ticks.
